title: Widening a Datetime of huge counts to microseconds wraps
description: Casting an Arrow `timestamp[s]` holding 2^62 (read as `Datetime("ms")`) to `Datetime("us")` multiplies by 1000 without a check: the count wraps. DuckDB raises `ConversionException` ("Could not convert Timestamp(S) to Timestamp(US)"). Inside 0001..9999 (D32) nothing wraps.
A scan that widens s and ms to microseconds needs a range check on Polars.
reference: D61: s and ms are read as microseconds, exactly; D32 bounds the years.

provenance.notes: Polars 2.1.0 (Python). DuckDB 2.0.0: `ConversionException` on the same table.
